title: South Korea reports that, for the first 20 days of July, chip exports climbed 180.6% from the same period in 2025; computer-related product shipments grew ~232% (Heesu Lee/Bloomberg)
summary: Heesu Lee / Bloomberg: South Korea reports that, for the first 20 days of July, chip exports climbed 180.6% from the same period in 2025; computer-related product shipments grew ~232% — South Korea's exports extended robust growth in early July as artificial intelligence-driven demand for semiconductors continued to fuel the economy.
